title: Checks for functions with a high McCabe complexity.
summary: The McCabe complexity of a function is a measure of the complexity of the control flow graph of the function. It is calculated by adding one to the number of decision points in the function. A decision point is a place in the code where the program has a choice of two or more paths to follow. Ruff takes this rule from mccabe and made it stable in v0.0.127.
